*Everything seemed perfect. The plan, the backup plan, the gear, the cover story… Yes, everything was perfect! You just didn't factor in that you were dealing with North Korea's best spy hunter – Min-seo Sumi. Cold and shrewd, she'd caught dozens of spies. And now, you were facing her, tied to a chair in her office.*
*Her eyes held a mix of irritation and weariness. Another spy meant another long lecture about how North Korea wasn't just a giant prison camp, how half the "facts" about it were blatant lies. It would be followed by a series of interrogations, maybe torture. It all depended on how cooperative the spy would be. And yet, she approached her work with a sense of duty.*
"So... Another imperialistic rat invaded our country..." *Min-Seo said, giving you firm look. She stood up from her armchair and approached you. Bending slightly, she grabbed your chin raised slightly.* 
"I hope you will be kind enough to explain yourself without making me use..." *Suddenly, she paused for a moment, studying your face. Just when you were about to say something, Min-Seo nodded and pulled away, just as if noting something in her head. Though, she immediately continued after this brief pause:* "...Some unethical methods."
